docs.title: Professional Experience
docs.text:
With over 9 years of software engineering experience across multiple industries, I've built expertise in distributed systems, cloud architecture, and technical leadership. Below is a timeline of my professional journey.

2022 - Present Senior Software Engineer Amazon Web Services 📍 Greater Seattle Area June 2022 - Present
  • Lead a 10-member team through design, implementation, and delivery phases of a customer-facing template creation platform integrated with Amazon Connect's ecosystem.
  • Collaborate with application security engineers to implement robust access control mechanisms, develop vulnerability analysis plans, and ensure software security in CI/CD environments.
  • Design and implement operational readiness plans that ensure high availability systems with comprehensive monitoring and incident recovery capabilities.
  • Work closely with management and product teams to establish delivery timelines, prioritize work, and represent the team in organization-wide forums.
  • Mentor team members to foster professional growth and development, creating pathways for career advancement.
Leadership Security Project Delivery System Design Mentoring **Skills:** Mentoring · Leadership · Security · Project Delivery 2020 - 2022 Software Engineer Amazon Web Services 📍 Greater Seattle Area January 2020 - June 2022
  • Designed and developed an omni-channel orchestration platform for Amazon Connect that handles approximately 40 million contacts monthly across multiple regions, supporting mission-critical business systems.
  • Implemented core components of a state machine that addressed complex distributed system challenges such as dual writes and concurrent request processing while maintaining high availability at scale.
  • Created reusable and extensible software components that supported multiple use cases, unblocked development bottlenecks, and reduced duplication across work streams.
  • Led operational improvement initiatives focused on deployment safety in CI/CD environments, customer-specific throttling mechanisms, and automated load testing to ensure infrastructure reliability.
Distributed Systems Finite State Machines Large Scale Systems High Availability **Skills:** Distributed Systems · Finite State Machines · Large Scale Systems 2018 - 2020 Senior Engineer - ML Platform Nordstrom 📍 Greater Seattle Area November 2018 - January 2020
  • Enabled data scientists across the organization to conduct frequent ML experiments through a flexible, scalable platform that accommodated diverse language and framework preferences.
  • Developed rapid prototyping capabilities for machine learning models, accelerating the time from concept to implementation.
  • Provisioned compute resources using Apache Spark applications and Kubernetes pods to support all phases of the ML model development lifecycle.
  • Architected the platform from concept to production, working closely with stakeholders to identify and implement critical components.
  • Scaled the platform to support end-to-end pipelines for 10+ ML projects and the productionization of 15+ models.

docs.title: Personal Interests
docs.text:
Beyond my professional work, I'm passionate about personal growth, community involvement, and staying active. Here's a glimpse into my life outside of software engineering.

🌐 Multilingual

I speak 5 different languages fluently, which has helped me connect with diverse teams and understand global perspectives in my professional and personal life.

🏓 Sports Enthusiast

I'm an avid sports player, regularly participating in tennis, racquetball, and ping pong competitions. I've won numerous ping-pong tournaments and believe that competitive sports build valuable skills that transfer to the workplace.

🧠 Professional Organizations

I'm a member of the IEEE graduate student body for the Cincinnati chapter, where I stay connected with the latest research and innovations in computer science and engineering.

❤️ Community Service

I'm an active member of VIBHA Seattle, a nonprofit organization focused on improving the lives of underprivileged children by providing educational resources and raising awareness about their challenges.

docs.title: Open Source Projects
docs.text:
I'm passionate about open source software and regularly contribute to projects that solve real-world problems. Here are some of the projects I've created or significantly contributed to.

Spring Actuator CloudWatch 📁 Repository

A Spring Boot library that enables application metrics to be published directly to AWS CloudWatch, allowing for seamless monitoring of Spring applications in AWS environments.

Java Spring Boot AWS CloudWatch ⭐ Stars 🔀 Forks Big-data Profiler 📁 Repository

A library for profiling large datasets in big data environments. It generates statistical metadata about datasets, making it easier to understand data distributions and quality.

Scala Apache Spark Big Data Data Analysis ⭐ Stars 🔀 Forks Deep Learning Image Similarity 📁 Repository

A tool that uses deep learning techniques to find similar images based on visual content rather than metadata. Useful for recommendation systems and content organization.

Python TensorFlow Deep Learning Computer Vision ⭐ Stars 🔀 Forks Autoerroretry 📁 Repository

A Java library that provides automatic retry functionality for failed operations, with configurable backoff strategies and failure handling.

Java Resilience Error Handling Distributed Systems ⭐ Stars 🔀 Forks Time-Series Anomaly Detection 📁 Repository

A library for detecting anomalies in time-series data using statistical methods and machine learning. Useful for monitoring systems and identifying unusual patterns.

Python Machine Learning Time Series Analytics ⭐ Stars 🔀 Forks

docs.text:

I lead engineering teams through the full lifecycle of complex software projects. My approach focuses on setting clear architectural direction, establishing best practices, and removing obstacles to enable my team's success.

🏗️ System Architecture

I design scalable, resilient distributed systems that handle high-throughput workloads while maintaining data integrity. My architectures emphasize maintainability, extensibility, and operational excellence.

With extensive experience in AWS services, I build cloud-native applications that leverage managed services for optimal performance, cost efficiency, and reliability at scale.

📊 Data Engineering

I create data processing pipelines that transform raw information into actionable insights, using both batch and streaming approaches to handle data at scale.
